scenarios.description: stable retained objects with focus/value churn and explicit paint order

probeEventsPerFrame.note: Probe IR objects plus render/layout operations observed for one frame.

bytesPerFrame.note: Length-prefixed snapshot frame, including the four-byte wire header.

fullSnapshots.note: The current TypeScript probe transport sends one full snapshot per benchmark frame.

deltas.note: The current TypeScript probe transport does not advertise or emit tree-diffs.

droppedEvents.reason: The synchronous semantic pipeline has no bounded producer queue; only a live transport can observe backpressure drops.

coalescedEvents.reason: The synchronous semantic pipeline does not coalesce frames; framework sessions must report this from their live render hook.

unknownFrameworkNodesPerFrame.note: Semantic nodes normalized to generic because no stronger portable role was proven.

renderCorrelationRate.reason: This benchmark has no PTY or render-marker consumer; correlation belongs to end-to-end session telemetry.

probeSerializationTime.note: Production encodeFrame JSON serialization, UTF-8 encoding and length prefix.

parentNormalizationTime.reason: The current JavaScript probes normalize Probe IR before publication; the parent receives an already normalized semantic snapshot.

parentProtocolValidationTime.note: Production parent frame decode, immutable DTO projection, schema checks and semantic validation; this is validation, not semantic normalization.

probeHotPathTime.note: Recognizer normalization plus serialization on the current JavaScript probe path; excludes framework observation and socket I/O.

applicationOverheadRatio.reason: A pure semantic-pipeline benchmark has no uninstrumented framework process to compare against.

caveats: CPU timings describe the semantic pipeline, not whole-application wall-clock slowdown.
Framework observation and socket/PTY scheduling require framework-specific end-to-end measurements.
Unavailable metrics remain null with a reason; the report never substitutes an inferred zero.
